items.title: Reservoir Expands Its Suno and Anthropic Infringement Lawsuits; Publisher Now Seeks Nearly $450 Million in Statutory Damages
items.summary: Reservoir Media has supersized its Suno and Anthropic copyright infringement complaints, which are now demanding a combined total of nearly $450 million in statutory damages. New York City-headquartered Reservoir fired off the expanded actions yesterday, weeks after submitting the original complaints. As we broke down…

items.title: Elvis Presley Enterprises Slaps Suno With Copyright & NIL Suit, Says the Platform Was ‘Always Meant to Replace the Artists Whose Works and Identities Were Being Unlawfully Copied’
items.summary: Another day, another AI infringement lawsuit – this time against Suno, which is accused of infringing a number of Elvis Presley copyrights as well as the King of Rock’s name, image, and likeness (NIL) rights. Plaintiffs including Elvis Presley Enterprises, Raleigh Music Publishing, and a subsidiary of Elvis IP owner Au…

items.title: Suno argues that judge should throw out musician’s publicity rights lawsuit
items.summary: Suno is fighting several music industry lawsuits, but one stands out - filed by musician Jason Isbell - because it accuses the AI company of infringing publicity rights by connecting artist names to musical styles in the back-end. Suno has responded to that lawsuit, urging the judge to dismiss it

Suno boss talks streaming fraud: ‘AI music is not a crime’
items.summary: Suno CEO Mikey Shulman has criticised what he describes as a “sleight of hand” of “equating streaming fraud with AI music”, while stressing that his company is doing more work behind the scenes to tackle fraud than people realise. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Los covers necesitan licencia aunque des crédito
tip.body: Acreditar al autor no sustituye la licencia. Para publicar un cover en plataformas necesitas la licencia mecánica correspondiente, y para usarlo en video, además, la sincronización.

tip.title: Covers need a license even if you give credit
tip.body: Crediting the songwriter is not a license. Releasing a cover on platforms requires a mechanical license, and using it in a video also requires a sync license.
